responsibility: This header defines the `a64fx_tunings` cost model for Fujitsu A64FX within the AArch64 backend. It packages the microarchitecture-specific address costs, register-move penalties, AdvSIMD and SVE vector costs, prefetch parameters, issue rate, alignment preferences, reassociation widths, SVE width selection, and load/store-pair policy that the backend uses when `-mtune=a64fx` or related CPU selections request A64FX-specific scheduling and profitability heuristics.
